subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR require latest-head real behavior proof for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The code shape follows the prior maintainer direction, but the remaining gap is proof sufficiency for upgraded persisted state plus acceptance of a compatibility-sensitive runtime stale-detection branch.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Override Based On Source And Tests
options.body: Maintainers can accept the source proof and regression tests as enough, but that explicitly waives external real-behavior proof for upgraded persisted state.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: If runtime invalidation for legacy no-code rows is not acceptable, pause this PR and make doctor or migration code own that cleanup path.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: This person gave the prior explicit-marker direction on the predecessor PR and has recent history on the affected plugin registry paths.
